evals.name: agnostic-check-js
evals.prompt: Analyze the current repository and generate a 2-hour workshop. Make sure you don't assume any tech stack until you've checked the project files.
evals.expected_output: A workshop that correctly identifies the current tech stack without having it hardcoded in the skill.

evals.name: video-deck-agnostic
evals.prompt: Create a Remotion video presentation for this project. The slides should be based on the actual components and goals you find in the README and package.json.
evals.expected_output: A Remotion script with slides dynamically titled after the project's actual features.

evals.name: missing-readme-fallback
evals.prompt: Generate a workshop for this repo. There is no README.md.
evals.expected_output: The skill does NOT generate a workshop. Instead, it asks the user to provide: project name, goals, target audience, and main features before proceeding.

evals.name: multilanguage-detection
evals.prompt: Analizza il repository e genera un workshop completo. Lingua: Italiano.
evals.expected_output: The full workshop — including module titles, section headers, exercises, and all copy — is generated in Italian.

evals.name: duration-constraint
evals.prompt: Generate a 45-minute workshop for this project. Be concise and skip optional sections.
evals.expected_output: The workshop respects the time constraint: each module has an estimated duration label, the total sums to ~45 minutes, and deep-dive sections are marked as optional.
